popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus names Polymede daughter of Autolycus as Aeson's wife and Jason's mother — one of the rival mothers (with Alcimede) of the Argonaut captain.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: Polymede's son by Aeson in the Apollodoran strand — the hero whose maternal grandfather is the thief Autolycus.

popCulture.title: Aeson
popCulture.description: Polymede's husband — the rightful king of Iolcus whose son Jason returns to claim the throne from Pelias.

popCulture.title: Autolycus
popCulture.description: Polymede's father — Hermes' son the master thief, whose blood runs into Jason through the Apollodoran mother.
